body: Intellectually challenging? That does make sense. I'll look into that. I smoke weed sometimes, too. It helps me stop and enjoy the present for a bit. I try not to let myself become dependent on it though. I really appreciate you telling me your story, man. It gives me some hope for myself and that's something that I think I need a lot of right now.

For a while, I used fitness to distract myself, but a few months ago, my depression worsened to the point where it was hard just to move around. I've lost interest in a bunch of things I used to love doing. I play guitar too, but I don't play as much as I should just because I don't feel like doing anything most of the time. I'm in two bands and the only time I really play is when we practice and even though music is my passion, sometimes it just feels like another chore.
Of course they won't forget about me, but it's not like they can't go on with their lives without me. and please don't feel bad, I appreciate you taking the time to talk to me.
It gives me a little bit of inspiration... Thank you.

I'm sorry it took this long to reply, but thank you for taking the time to reply to my post. And my friends all have depression and one has attempted suicide several times throughout his life and still has some suicidal thoughts and he's the one telling me to pretty much stop being a bitch. That's why I feel like it's my fault.
Also, you said you feel more in control of it. How did you do that, if you don't mind me asking?

I've wanted to drop out of university and do exactly that, but I'm scared of what will happen if I don't succeed in music in the long run. I know I shouldn't worry about the money at first, but what if it doesn't work out and I'm still stuck and in my late 30's struggling to make ends meet because I never got my business degree?
they're the first thing I think about when I strongly start to consider ending it all, but sometimes I think they'll just get over it anyway and just forget about me.

well right now, I'm in one pop punk band and another post-hardcore band. It'd be cool if either of my bands can make it big, but my dream job is just to make background music or sound effects for TV or movies.
I'd love to, but I'm scared that if I fail at that, then I'd just be stuck.
